sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This second application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.125/2022 registered at Police Station Ashbagh, District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 25.05.2022.
The applicant's earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to move fresh application after a period of five months.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that statement of prosecutrix has been recorded.
He submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the alleged offence for the reason that prosecutrix is his step sister.
He further submits father of the present applicant solemnized two marriages and is residing separately with his second wife since last 20 years.
He submits that from his first wife, he has two children and the present applicant is one of them.
He submits that when the present applicant attained majority, he went to his father asking share in the property and then in a planned manner, false case got registered against the present applicant.

He submits that prosecutix has admitted this fact that after the incident, she did not disclose the fact of committing rape to anybody for a period of six months and thereafter she disclosed this fact to her mother and then report was made to the police and offence as such got registered against the present applicant.
He submits that looking to the facts and circumstances and the relationship between the parties, it is clear that present applicant has been falsely implicated.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that the age of the prosecutrix at the time of incident was 14 years and from her cross-examination, it is clear that the dispute was not with regard to demand of any share in the property of his father but it is otherwise.
He therefore, submitted that under the circumstances, the bail application of the present applicant deserves to be dismissed.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary; the fact that statement of the prosecutrix has already been recorded and the present applicant being an under trial accused in jail since 25.05.2022, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.
